name: Sophia Ascart
original_name: ソフィア・アスカルト
source:
Nicol's sister and the rival character during his path in the game, though details regarding her story are sparse; since Catarina never played that route. She was considered cursed due to her silver hair and red eyes, causing her to live a life of isolation until she met Catarina and opened up to her because of Catarina's genuine compliments and offer to be her friend.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Next_Life_as_a_Villainess:_All_Routes_Lead_to_Doom!]Wikipedia[/url]]

Nicol's sister and the rival character during his path in the game, though details regarding her story are sparse; since Catarina never played that route.
